args.body: Use the committed director-channel-evidence.json and SBA SUBNet capture as channel evidence for INVENTORY-FILE-QA-SUBCONTRACT. The broad search headings were unrelated. If the mission is still active and its source allowance permits, use the published SUBNet keyword filter for one targeted check and verify from the returned page that the filter applied. Treat a listing as a lead until the original request establishes scope, current deadline, supplier eligibility and response route. Run the existing passing and failing controls and prepare a private quote only for a qualifying request. Otherwise record the precise coverage limit and what would reopen this channel. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson under a valid lease. No external contact or spending.
